# Demo day: what the engine should do

<!-- Generated by `npm run -w @turn/db db:seed:demo` from the engine itself.
     packages/db/test/demo.test.ts rebuilds the demo and fails if this file drifts. -->

Load it with `npm run up -- -Demo` (resets the local database). Then sign in as Phu or Hạnh
and open the board. Clock times change with every load; the order and the numbers below do not.
Valid for about 10 minutes after loading: after that Thảo's appointment gets close enough to
start, and timers move on. Load again for a fresh copy.

## Rules in force

- A service: +1. A fill or full set: +½. Services in one visit add up, but a visit with a fill or full set in it is capped at 1.
- An appointment visit: its services −½. A technician whose last visit was an appointment sorts after others at the same points (0 before 00).
- A deny: +1, unless a manager excuses it. Out longer than 60 min: +1.
- Late start: 15+ min +½, 30+ min +1, 60+ min not decided yet.
- Ties go to the earlier check-in. An appointment within 30 min holds its technician out of the line.
- A requested technician skips the line: the visit waits for her.

## The board, in queue order

| Turn | Tech | Status | Points | Checked in | How the points add up |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 1 | Thảo | available | ½ | 5th | +1 denied a call (break needed); −1 deny excused by the owner; +½ Gel fill |
| 2 | Tâm | on break | ½ | 6th | +½ late start (17 min late) |
| 3 | Linh | available | ½ | 4th | +½ Gel manicure (appointment) |
| 4 | Vân | available | 1 | 1st | +1 out over 60 min |
| 5 | Mai | available | 1 | 2nd | +1 denied a call (other) |
| 6 | Hoa | with a client | 1½ | 3rd | +½ Acrylic fill; +1 Gel manicure |

Why this order:

- Thảo before Tâm: same points, Thảo checked in earlier (5th vs 6th).
- Tâm before Linh: same points, but Linh's last visit was an appointment.
- Linh before Vân: fewer points (½ vs 1).
- Vân before Mai: same points, Vân checked in earlier (1st vs 2nd).
- Mai before Hoa: fewer points (1 vs 1½).
